description: Records that the merchant sent a due notice (ntd_…), optionally with the email provider's message id. Idempotent. Only call this after the email was actually sent: a send before the window opens is refused, and an overdue notice marked sent is recorded as late. For an overdue notice that was not and will not be sent, pass missed: true (with a reason) instead: it is recorded as missed, no send is attested.

missed.description: true: record an overdue notice as NOT sent (markNoticeMissed) instead of sent.

provider_message_id.description: The email provider's message id (Resend / Postmark / SES).

reason.description: With missed: why it was not sent.

sent_at.description: When it was sent (unix seconds); default now.

name: mark_notice_sent
title: Mark a required email as sent (or missed)
